company_name: National Chung-Shan Institute of Science & Technology
semiconductor_relevance: Low — the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology primarily focuses on national defense technology and general science and technology research rather than semiconductor-specific products or services.
summary: The National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST) is dedicated to research and development in national defense technology, promoting military and civilian technology advancements. While it engages in technology transfer and industrial services, its focus is not specifically on semiconductor manufacturing or development.
